"Extract invoice details with AI" (cradlAi.parse) only approximates the original; review it before relying on the result.
Setup value spreadsheetId: Google Sheets spreadsheet id (from the sheet URL) (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value sheetName: Sheet tab name (for example Sheet1). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Workflow secret CRADL_API_KEY: Cradl AI API key for api.cradl.ai (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: "Gmail Trigger" is a provider webhook (googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE --account <connectedAccountId>`.
"Extract invoice details with AI" (cradlAi.parse): Cradl document parse over HTTP; the document has to be uploaded first, which the JSON-only HTTP step cannot do.
"Add invoice line to Google Sheets" mapped columns automatically; here each item's fields are appended in their own order, so keep them in the same order as the sheet's header row.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
### How it works
1. Invoices are imported from GMail  
2. Data is extracted with Cradl AI  
3. The extracted data is then written to Google Sheets  

### Setup
* **Cradl AI action**. Click [here](https://rc.app.cradl.ai/login?redirect=signup&template=n8n%2Finvoices-gmail-to-sheets.json) to create a free Cradl AI account. Choose _n8n_ when prompted for integrations, then follow the setup instructions in the node.  
* **GMail trigger**. Connect with GMail and customize email filters. For example, if you have a shared mailbox where you receive inboxes you may want to add `to:[email removed]` to the _Search filter_ parameter. 
* **Google Sheets action**. Connect your credentials and map the extracted fields from the Cradl AI output to Google Sheets.  

### Customize
* The fields that are extracted can be easily customized by logging into your Cradl AI account and updating your agent definition.  
* Validation rules and reviewers (e.g. from your accounting team) can be added as **human-in-the-loop validators** directly in your Cradl AI account.

### Pull invoices from GMail
This trigger starts the workflow by getting your invoice file. You can easily swap it with other triggers that fetch files (PDFs or images) from sources like Gmail, webhooks, or cloud storage.

### Export invoice to Google Sheets
You can easily swap this out for other destinations, such as accounting tools like Xero or QuickBooks, or a database or data warehouse.

### Extract and validate invoice
This node extracts and validates data from invoices. It also includes built-in human-in-the-loop capabilities, so you can review, approve, or correct the data  through a simple interface. [Read more.](https://docs.cradl.ai)
